sloka: द्वौ च खड्गौ रथगतौ पार्श्वस्थौ पार्श्वशोभितौ।चतुर्हस्तत्सरुयुतौ व्यक्तहस्तदशायतौ ।। ६.७१.२१ ।।
transliteration: dvau ca khaḍgau rathagatau pārśvasthau pārśvaśobhitau।caturhastatsaruyutau vyaktahastadaśāyatau ।। 6.71.21 ।।

translations.english: "It has two swords off our cubits and ten cubits long swords provided with hilts hanging on its sides as decoration."
